@graph.name: Records of the qualifying species inside Kras (SI3000276), GBIF
@graph.description: GBIF occurrence records of the 25 species and subspecies of the site's Standard Data Form, from download https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.5epzsz (423 records in a shape covering the site), clipped to the exact site boundary: 290 presence records kept. Each record is placed on HEALPix depth 13 (~796 m, WGS84, NESTED) with the cells its stated positional uncertainty covers, by healpix-connector 0.1.0. Records are opportunistic observations: their number per year reflects observer effort as much as occurrence, so counts are not abundance and a change in records is not a change in population. 164 of the 423 records come from iNaturalist Research-grade Observations. Licence is GBIF's for the download (the most restrictive of its datasets). Observer names are not included.
@graph.creditText: BMD Single Access Point prototype (A. Fouilloux), whose data builders are reused here (vendored in pipeline/builders/); FAIR2Adapt (FAIR to Adapt to Climate Change), European Commission grant 101188256, which funded the prototype code
